piezas.titulo: Vocabulary: Digital media and information quality
texto: Vocabulary for media literacy, information verification and source analysis in digital environments: «แหล่งข่าว» (lɛ̀ɛng-khàao, news source / origin of the report), «ตรวจสอบ» (dtrùat-sɔ̀ɔp, to verify / cross-check / audit), «เผยแพร่» (phə̌əi-phrɛ̂ɛ, to spread / publish / disseminate) and «น่าเชื่อถือ» (nâa-chʉ̂ʉa-thʉ̌ʉ, reliable / trustworthy / credible). To link prior verification with dissemination use «ก่อนเผยแพร่ข้อมูล» (before spreading information). For complex explanatory contrasts: «ไม่เพียงแต่... แต่ยัง...» (not only... but also...). For analytical concessions of caution: «แม้... แต่ยังควร...» (although... one should still...).
